description:
Flaccy plays the music you own at full quality: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3 and AAC. A real equalizer, gapless playback, synced lyrics you can share as a video, Last.fm scrobbling, a full iPad layout and a standalone Apple Watch app. No account, no ads, and your files never leave your device.

SEE EXACTLY WHAT YOU'RE HEARING
• Codec, bit depth and sample rate on every track, from CD quality to Hi-Res
• Gapless playback that honors your albums (exact for lossless files), with a queue that survives relaunches

A REAL EQUALIZER
• Drag the curve and hear it change, or switch to Advanced for up to ten bands with bells, shelves, filters and adjustable Q
• 16 presets and your own. Import Equalizer APO and AutoEq profiles to tune for your headphones
• A separate setting for every output: AirPods, a wired DAC, the speaker. Flaccy switches when you do
• Automatic headroom keeps boosts from clipping, and Hold to compare is level-matched, so louder never sounds better
• Works with every format and keeps playback gapless. Off or flat, the signal passes through untouched

YOUR LIBRARY, ORGANIZED
• Bring music in from the Files app, USB, a NAS or any folder; Flaccy keeps your folder structure
• Messy filenames and scene releases are identified and cleaned up automatically (AI cleanup is included in the trial and in Lifetime)
• Albums, artists, songs and playlists with fast search, flexible sorting and large artwork you can replace with your own
• Duplicate songs are listed once, and Flaccy builds smart playlists from your own listening

MADE FOR LISTENING
• Home picks up where you left off, with mixes made from your own listening and what you played on this day in years past
• Synced lyrics that fill in word by word when a song has word timing, with tap-to-seek and a timing control for songs that run off
• Share Lyrics: pick the lines you love and get a short video of them over the song itself, in four looks and four formats for Stories, posts and more
• Full controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, AirPlay and a sleep timer
• Six themes that change the colors, type and cover shapes, and four ways to see your albums: grid, wall, list or carousel
• A Now Playing screen worth looking at, in light or dark

BUILT FOR IPAD
• A sidebar for your library and every playlist, with Now Playing and Up Next in a column beside it
• Lyrics and the queue spread across the screen next to the artwork
• Keyboard shortcuts, the menu bar, pointer support and drag and drop: songs into Up Next or onto a playlist, audio files straight from Files

YOUR SERVER, TOO
• Play from Navidrome, Flaccy Server or any OpenSubsonic server, over your home network or Tailscale
• Songs stream without filling your iPhone or iPad and download for offline when you want them
• One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch

SCROBBLE EVERYTHING
• Sign in with Last.fm and every play is scrobbled, even offline, with automatic retry
• Listening charts, artist bios and a wantlist for the records you're hunting
• Year in Music: shareable story cards and a poster of your listening year

APPLE WATCH, NO PHONE NEEDED
• Sync tracks to your watch and play them offline
• A true standalone player with gapless playback, shuffle, repeat and AirPods controls
• Storage-smart sync that knows what fits

TRY IT FREE
Flaccy is free for 7 days from the first time you play your own music. After that, keep everything with a one-time Lifetime purchase, or choose the yearly plan. The yearly plan renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Flaccy plays FLAC, ALAC, AAC, M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF and CAF.

Privacy Policy: https://mako.midgarcorp.cc/privacy/flaccy

whatsNew:
Flaccy 2.0.

Flaccy opens 2.0 with a short look at everything it can do. Here is what is new.

THEMES
Six themes change how all of Flaccy looks: its colors, its type, the shape of its covers and how Albums is laid out. Phosphor is green on black in a monospaced face, Liner Notes is paper with serif titles, Hi-Fi cuts its covers round, Gallery is a wall of covers, Marquee shows one cover at a time, and Flaccy is the look you know.
Albums has four views now: a grid, a wall of covers, a list and a carousel. Each theme picks one, and the layout button switches it.
Your own cover shape, corners and font sit over whichever theme is on, and you can copy any theme to change it: a theme is a folder holding one text file.
Themes are in Settings under Appearance. Your Apple Watch follows your iPhone.

CLEAN LIBRARY
One switch, Clean Library, replaces Hide Duplicate Songs and Group Album Editions. Every song is listed once, wherever its copies live: on this device, on a server, or under another artist credit on the same album.
The Library's header scrolls away with the list and comes back on the first move up, so the list has the whole screen.

PLAYLISTS, REMASTERED
A playlist page updates as it changes, whether from a drop, another screen or a sync.
Tap a playlist's name to rename it, sort it six ways, search inside it, and move a song with a long press and drag.
Swipe to queue or remove, with Undo. Songs the library has lost stay as dimmed rows you can take out.
Suggested Songs from your own library sit under every playlist and add with one tap. Add Songs is a searchable sheet that marks what the playlist already holds.

YOUR SERVER
When a server has songs this device also holds, Flaccy offers to free up the space or keep them downloaded. Plays, loves, playlist places and song volume stay with each song.
Download Quality in Settings › Servers: Original File, AAC 256 kbps or AAC 128 kbps.
Once a server is added, an Offline chip in the Library keeps the songs that play with no server in reach.
A large server's library fills in while its first sync is still reading.

IPAD
Lyrics and the queue stay inside the Now Playing column, so the library is still there to browse. Spread the player over the window when you want it.
In landscape and in a shared window, the controls sit where your thumbs are.
On an iPad mini held sideways, the sidebar and the Now Playing column take turns.
Songs drag by their grabbers again in Up Next and in a playlist.

PLAYBACK
After Another App Plays, in Settings › Playback: Flaccy picks the music back up when the other app goes quiet, only after calls and Siri, or stays paused.

ALSO
Home opens on the page it kept, and a large library is back about twice as fast.
Search results have the Library's long-press menus: Play Next, Add to Queue, Add to Playlist and more.
Albums of MP3 and M4A files are listed in track order again.
If your free trial ended a month or more ago, Flaccy gets a second look: seven more free days, starting when your own music plays.
The tab bar has its background again on iOS 18, and the mini player keeps its controls as the tab bar minimizes.
Flaccy now sends anonymous crash reports beside its usage counts, so I can fix what breaks. Settings › About › Usage Counts shows exactly what is sent and turns it all off with one switch.
